svg.title: ATSker architecture
svg.desc: Users reach two isolated environments built from one container image: a private app with sign-in on Gemini 3.8 Flash, and a public demo without login on Claude Haiku 5.5 whose sessions are deleted after 24 hours. Each environment has its own Cloud Run service, Neon Postgres database and Secret Manager. Both call models through OpenRouter. GitHub Actions tests the code and deploys the image through Artifact Registry using Workload Identity Federation.
svg.text: Two isolated environments, one container image. Models are called only at the edges, through OpenRouter.
GCP project example-project · own Neon project
GCP project atsker-demo · own Neon project
no sign-up · CV file never stored
